title: Train NVH Monitoring and Analysis
seoDescription: imc measurement and data acquisition systems for rail vehicles and rail infrastructure: wheel-rail forces, wheelset vibration, brake and pantograph tests.

props.title: Train NVH Monitoring and Analysis
paragraphs: Since 1996 imc has developed measurement technology for the rail sector, from high-speed trains to streetcars. Rugged, distributed systems record thousands of channels under splash water, stone chipping, heat, cold and electromagnetic interference.
The systems read rail vehicle bus systems directly, calculate in real time and can be networked and synchronised, all configured from one software, imc STUDIO.

items.title: Direct reading of vehicle buses
items.text: Rail vehicle bus systems are read directly into the measurement system.

items.title: Rugged for railway loads
items.text: Hardware built for the shocks, temperatures and electromagnetic voltages of rail vehicles and infrastructure.

items.title: Distributed measurement
items.text: Signals are captured at the source, close to sensors installed at many points along the vehicle, and evaluated synchronously.

items.title: Real-time calculation
items.text: Results are calculated during the run, which saves evaluation time.

items.title: TEDS capable
items.text: Calibration values are read automatically from the sensors.

items.title: Networked and synchronised
items.text: Several systems can be combined and run in sync, with application-specific extensions.
